## THE DIGITAL ECONOMY CAPTURED

Capturing the Digital Economy: A Proposed Measurement Framework and its Applications is a special supplement to Key Indicators for Asia and the Pacific 2021. The report provides guidance on consistently measuring the digital economy based on a narrow set of core digital products and industries, namely hardware, software publishing, web publishing, telecommunications services, and specialized and support services.
